sections_target.text: Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System (MPIS)
System definition: It is a technique designed to provide the company with a systematic approach to documenting and implementing proper maintenance for network and station equipment.
The objective of establishing the system:

Providing the maintenance and testing teams in the production and transmission companies with a sustained capability to perform maintenance activities safely, effectively, on time and efficiently, by preparing documents from reliable information sources and presenting them in an easy-to-use paper and electronic form.
Improving the capability of personnel and the performance of equipment through preparing and implementing maintenance procedure documents.

items: Providing the maintenance and testing teams in the production and transmission companies with a sustained capability to perform maintenance activities safely, effectively, on time and efficiently, by preparing documents from reliable information sources and presenting them in an easy-to-use paper and electronic form.
Improving the capability of personnel and the performance of equipment through preparing and implementing maintenance procedure documents.

sections_target.text: Products

Maintenance procedure documents: detailed steps explaining how to perform maintenance work, including safety factors and the tools and equipment required to complete the work, taking environmental requirements into account.

Technical bulletins: explain information about network equipment problems and serve as a system for exchanging information about equipment maintenance problems and warning against hazards, by sharing the experience gained in how to avoid them / deal with them.
Technical directives: specify the types of maintenance required and their execution dates, and the directives and standard criteria for each piece of network equipment.
Target groups

Substation maintenance groups / protection and control equipment testing / overhead lines / oil testing at the central chemical laboratories, as well as the telecommunication equipment testing teams at the National Energy Control Centre of the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company, and the similar groups and subsidiary chemical laboratories in the production companies affiliated with the Egyptian Electricity Holding Company.
Supporting equipment

The central administration is equipped with a number of personal computers, software packages, printers and a plotter, with a total of 14 workstations connected to a server computer for the local computer network, and a scanner for entering documents as images for preservation in the administration's electronic archive.

The zones of the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company have been provided with a personal computer, software, a printer and a scanner, to produce and exchange information by e-mail over the information network of the Egyptian Electricity Holding Company.
More about the documents

The documents of the General Administration for Developing Maintenance Procedures Systems (technical procedures + technical directives + technical bulletins) are all based on the manufacturers' instructions and the experience gained in maintenance, guided by some documents produced by the Canadian Ontario Hydro company in the similar RTOS system.
Link to the work

The General Administration for Developing the Central Maintenance Procedures System maintains the relationships between it and the document users (the maintenance teams in the zones of the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company and the production companies) by updating the requirements to ensure that the information produced is linked to the needs and that the available resources have been used effectively to provide the correct information to the person concerned with implementing it at the right time.
Accuracy and safety

All documents were tested in practice at one of the sites before being approved and distributed for implementation, and some were tested more than once to implement suggestions made on them, to ensure the correctness of the information and safety in implementation.
Quality and ease of use

Every document passes, from production, through a quality assurance stage to ensure the user can easily understand it — the drawings and illustrative pictures were reviewed to ensure their intended meaning is clear and they are implemented correctly.
All documents are produced in Arabic as far as possible, and in English, to make them safe and easy to use.
Research, preparation and publishing
Research

Research is carried out in the various information sources, from the manufacturers' catalogues registered in the open documentation system on the local computer network in the administration's electronic library, or through scanning the company's maintenance instruction documents / maintenance procedure documents followed in other institutions / the worldwide Internet information network / international standard criteria such as ANSI or ASTM or IEEE... etc.
Preparation

Using the documented information and the experience gained from the work sites, the first draft of the document is prepared, then it is published on the MPISWeb site on the sector's server computer for comments, then the suggestions are entered on the draft, then it is republished for final comments, then the field test of the document is carried out, then it is approved by the head of the concerned sector in the company that has the equipment in question.
Publishing

Approved documents are distributed electronically on compact discs, and are also kept in folders, and this information is currently circulated through the MPIS computer network located at some work sites in the production and transmission companies of the Egyptian Electricity Holding Company.
For more information:
General Administration for Developing Maintenance Procedures Systems MPIS
